profiles.Summary: Half-Life: Alyx is a VR-only title and the Steam Deck does not support VR output, making it effectively unplayable on the device in its intended form — this is reflected in its Unsupported Deck verification status. No workaround exists to run the game in a flat/non-VR mode on the Deck without significant third-party modification, so all profiles below are theoretical estimates only.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck reports exist for actual gameplay because Half-Life: Alyx is VR-only and the Steam Deck has no VR output — all three profiles are theoretical hardware estimates only. If you somehow attach a SteamVR headset via a dock, check whether SteamVR initialises at all before adjusting any graphics settings.

MaxBattery.Notes: This profile is theoretical only — Half-Life: Alyx is VR-only and cannot be played on the Steam Deck without a SteamVR-compatible headset. Do not purchase this game expecting to play it on the Deck.

KnownIssues: VR Only: the game requires a SteamVR-compatible headset and cannot be played in flat/non-VR mode on the Steam Deck natively.
Steam Deck Unsupported: Valve officially marks this game as unsupported on the Deck due to the VR-only requirement.
No VR output hardware on the Steam Deck — the device has no DisplayPort Alt-mode or USB-C VR capability that SteamVR can use.
Even if launched, SteamVR will fail to initialise a headset and the game will not progress past the startup check.
